The '''Templexus of the Dramatic Arts''' was a venue in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was the venue at which [[Radanthus Mandelatara]]'s production ''[[Hearts of Empire]]'' plaid.
